context: A teacher walks a teen through research
purpose: Teach: 立ち向かう/人命/自白/撃っ/都知事/親近/疎通/便乗

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、論文、女性たち、本気で、困難に立ち向かう姿、本気で、丁寧に、扱っていましたね、本気で、立派、絶対、感心、本当に。
lines.en: Sakura — the way you handled those women facing hardship in your paper was truly thoughtful. I was genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Warm, steady opening. Clear admiration without excess. Slight pause before the final sentence, letting the compliment land. Engaged but not effusive.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦時、人命の軽さ、本気で、悲しい歴史、論文で、扱いました、絶対、本気で、忘れないように、訴えました、本当に、感謝。
lines.en: Thank you. In wartime, so much human life was treated as disposable. I wanted my paper to address that sad history — to make sure we don't forget what happened.
lines.style: Sincere and measured. Slight heaviness on the weight of the topic. Speaks with quiet purpose, not performing emotion but feeling it. Careful articulation on the serious parts.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦犯の自白の信憑性、本気で、論文で、扱っていましたね、絶対、本気で、視野、広い、本当に、立派、絶対、本気で、感心、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: And the way you questioned the credibility of war criminals' confessions — that showed real intellectual depth. It was impressive work.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost musing. Nods slightly in recognition of the complexity. Warm but analytical. Speaks a little slower, honoring the sophistication of what was done.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦時、市民を撃った悲劇、本気で、論文で、扱いました、絶対、本気で、心、痛む、内容でした、本当に、絶対、本気で、感謝。
lines.en: Yes. There was a tragedy in wartime — civilians shot indiscriminately. It was painful to write about, but the content needed to be there. Thank you for seeing that.
lines.style: Voice thins slightly with the weight of the subject. Steady underneath, but there's a quietness that shows this matters. Not apologetic, but grounded. Finishes with quiet gratitude.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦後、都知事選挙、本気で、混乱した時代、論文で、扱っていましたね、絶対、本気で、立派、本当に、感心、絶対、本気で、感謝、本当に。
lines.en: Your exploration of the postwar Tokyo gubernatorial elections and that chaotic period was handled with real care. That kind of nuance is rare.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation in the tone. Leans forward slightly in presence. Speaks with clear recognition of the work's quality. Warm approval, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦後、人々の親近感、本気で、求めた背景、論文で、扱いました、絶対、本気で、現代にも、繋がる、本当に、深い、絶対。
lines.en: Thank you. I looked at how postwar people were searching for a sense of connection and belonging. It felt important to show how those historical currents still flow into today.
lines.style: Thoughtful and deliberate. A hint of pride in the insight, but not boastful — it's about the work mattering. Slight lift on 'still flow into today,' connecting past to present.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、敵国との意思疎通、本気で、難しかった、論文で、扱っていましたね、絶対、本気で、印象的、本当に、立派、絶対、本気で、感心。
lines.en: The way you tackled communication between enemies during wartime — how difficult that was — was really striking. That's the kind of observation that stays with someone.
lines.style: Slow, reflective opening. Weighs the idea before speaking it. Genuine appreciation underlying. Finishes with understated admiration, as if the insight surprised her too.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。便乗報道、戦時下も、本気で、問題、論文で、扱いました、絶対、本気で、現代にも、警鐘、絶対、本当に、感謝、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. Even wartime propaganda and bandwagon reporting — I needed to address how that worked then, and how it warns us about the same patterns now. Thank you for taking it seriously.
lines.style: Firm but not hard. There's conviction in the voice without being preachy. Final gratitude is warm and genuine, a quiet acknowledgment that she was heard. Finishes with quiet resolve.
